Newcastle battery firm Voltrax receives £1.2m UKRI award

Voltrax, a Newcastle startup building sodium-ion batteries, has received a £1.2 million grant award from UK Research and Innovation.

The non-dilutive grant supports the company's scale-up lab, and unlike an equity round it does not dilute the founding team.

Voltrax is one of twelve firms sharing £14 million from the agency's latest energy storage call.
